abstract: National Microbiome Data Collaborative (NMDC) unified data model

metadata.description: National Microbiome Data Collaborative (NMDC) unified data model
metadata.name: nmdc-schema

releases.body:
**This is a pre-release for testing:** `pip install nmdc-schema==11.25.0rc3`. Built with linkml and linkml-runtime 1.12.1. These notes cover everything since v11.24.1, not only since rc2.

## Summary

v11.25.0 removes the Biosample slot `collection_time_inc`, adds classes and slots for stable isotope probing (SIP) metagenomics, adds EMSL analysis types, imports its MIxS slots from MIxS v7.0.1 instead of v6.3.0, supports Python 3.14, and is built with linkml and linkml-runtime 1.12.1. It is a minor release even though it removes a slot. Removals in v11 have been released as minor versions, which does not match the rule in MAINTAINERS.md; that is being discussed in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/2876.

For consumers that read the generated JSON Schema, the linkml 1.12 build changes four things: id patterns now have the form `^(?:(nmdc):...)$` (for example `^(?:(nmdc):sty-([0-9][a-z]{0,6}[0-9])-([A-Za-z0-9]{1,}))$`), `type` also accepts the full class URI, optional enum- and class-ranged slots accept `null`, and slot examples appear in the JSON Schema. nmdc-runtime's ID minter reads only patterns that start `^(nmdc):`, so nmdc-runtime must take https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-runtime/pull/1659 (Read LinkML 1.12 wrapped id patterns in the minter's typecodes(); head 1171f379, which expects the `^(?:(nmdc):` form) in the same change that moves its pin to 11.25.0. What changes for each consumer and what each has to do is on this docs page: https://microbiomedata.github.io/nmdc-schema/release-11.25.0/

## Migration

`migrator_from_11_24_1_to_11_25_0` changes no data. It fails if any `biosample_set` document still has `collection_time_inc`. No other change can invalidate existing data: a SchemaView diff from v11.24.1 found `collection_time_inc` was the only removal, the MIxS v7.0.1 import leaves the JSON Schema unchanged apart from descriptions, titles and examples, and on 2026-10-15 none of 1,902,502 patterned values or 51,744,347 functional_annotation_agg documents in production failed the new patterns.

## Schema changes

- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3396 (Add new classes for SIP metagenomics data modeling), by @aclum. Adds the classes `IsotopeLabelingProcess`, `DensityGradientFractionationProcess`, `IsotopologAddition` and `IsotopologComposition`, 16 slots, and the enums `IsotopeEnum`, `IsotopologApproachEnum` and `IsotopologLabelEnum`. Adds permissible values to `ChemicalEntityEnum`, `ProtocolCategoryEnum` (`stable_isotope_probing`), `ProtocolForEnum` and `UnitEnum` (`g/mL`).
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3499 (Record which slot each method slot describes), by @turbomam. Adds a `method_for` annotation to 21 method slots, for example `ph_meth` gets `method_for: ph`.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3483 (Add interpolated: true to three id structured patterns), by @turbomam. Fixes the `id` patterns of `ChromatographicSeparationProcess`, `Manifest` and `MixingProcess`, which linkml 1.12 would otherwise leave as literal `{id_nmdc_prefix}` text. The expanded patterns are unchanged under linkml 1.11.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3508 (Remove the yq lines that create an empty `internal_standard` slot), by @turbomam. Removes an unused stub slot. It was introduced after v11.24.1, so v11.24.1 users see no change.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3471 (Add EMSL specific analysis types to support user submissions), by @bmeluch. Adds 10 permissible values to `AnalysisTypeEnum`, matching the analysis options in the EMSL submission templates, for example `proteomics`, `isotope profiling` and `imaging - xray`. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/2629 and https://github.com/microbiomedata/issues/issues/1137.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3524 (Give each schema module its own copy of the settings its patterns use), by @turbomam. linkml-runtime 1.12 fills in a `structured_pattern` only from the `settings:` of the module that defines it (https://github.com/linkml/linkml/issues/4135), so each module now carries a copy of the settings it uses, kept in sync from `nmdc.yaml` by `src/scripts/sync_module_settings.py`. Patterns resolve the same under 1.11.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3519 (Keep five descriptions to the definition and move the rest to comments), by @turbomam. Text only. Three of the changed descriptions are `MetadataBadgeEnum` values, which the Data Portal shows as badge tooltips.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3542 (Fix 16 spelling errors in schema descriptions and docs), by @turbomam. Text only.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3544 (Keep the base id slot's MAG example out of every class's id), by @turbomam. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3540 (Under linkml 1.12, every class's id example is the base slot's MAG id, which fails 40 class patterns).
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3545 (Give each class its own id example, using production ids), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3501 (Import MIxS v7.0.1), by @turbomam. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3480 (Import MIxS v7.0.1 (we still import v6.3.0)). All 504 imported MIxS slots now come from MIxS v7.0.1; 492 of them moved from v6.3.0. NMDC keeps the name `estimated_size` (MIxS renamed it `estimated_genome_size`, recorded as a structured alias) and keeps `env_medium` single-valued (MIxS v7.0.0 made it multivalued), so no migrator is needed: JSON Schema built from main and from the branch on 2026-10-14 was identical apart from descriptions, titles and examples. `salinity_meth`, which MIxS dropped after v6.1.1, now uses the default `nmdc:` URI and no longer maps to MIXS:0000341, which returns 404. Approved by @mslarae13. Adopting `estimated_genome_size` (https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3526) or a multivalued `env_medium` (https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3527) later would need a migrator.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3549 (Leave anchoring of structured patterns to linkml), by @turbomam. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3539. linkml 1.12 adds its own `^(?:...)$` around structured patterns, so rc2 shipped doubled anchors such as `^(?:^(nmdc):sty-...$)$`. 107 structured patterns drop their own `^` and `$`, so all 40 NMDC id patterns now read `^(?:(nmdc):...)$`. What matches is unchanged. Three of 522 patterns stay doubled: `salinity_meth` (kept for submission-schema, which resolves patterns with linkml-runtime 1.9.5) and the imported MIxS slots `cult_root_med` and `genetic_mod`.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3555 (Correct the MIxS release that dropped host_family_relation and soil_text_measure), by @turbomam. Text only: the notes on those two slots now say MIxS dropped them in v6.2.0, not v6.2.2.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3516 (Record structured alias origins in source, not contexts), by @turbomam. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3454. 14 structured aliases move their origin from `contexts` to `source`, and a new test requires a `source` on every structured alias. Alias metadata only.

## Removals and deprecations

- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3470 (Finalize deprecation of `collection_time_inc`), by @JamesTessmer. Removes `collection_time_inc` from `Biosample` and records it in `deprecated.yaml`. Use `collection_time` for the harvested sample's collection time.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3474 (Remove `collection_time_inc` rows from NCBI mapping and OLS4 alignment assets), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3478 (Record elements removed during v11 in deprecated.yaml, with a catalog of all removals), by @turbomam. Adds `make retired-element-catalog` and `assets/schema_element_history/retired_elements.tsv`.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3479 (Scan for retired element names in files nothing checks), by @turbomam.

## Migrator

- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3495 (Add a migrator check that fails on `collection_time_inc`), by @turbomam. `migrator_from_11_24_1_to_11_25_0` changes no data. It raises if any `biosample_set` document still has `collection_time_inc`, because there is no automatic place to move the value.

## Python package and dependencies

- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3511 (Prepare `get_typecode_for_future_ids` for LinkML v1.12 and add associated test), by @kheal. With linkml-runtime 1.12, `get_typecode_for_future_ids` returned `None` for several classes, which breaks ID minting. nmdc-schema allows `linkml-runtime>=1.9.0,<2.0.0`, and 1.12.0 has been on PyPI since 2026-10-08 (1.12.1 since 2026-10-13), so a pip install of v11.24.1 can already get the broken combination. This release fixes it for both 1.11 and 1.12.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3532 (Hold our lock at linkml-runtime 1.11 until nmdc-runtime can read wrapped id patterns), by @turbomam. Puts the repo's own lock back at linkml-runtime 1.11.1 after the Dependabot update in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3530 moved it to 1.12.1. A release built under 1.12 would ship id patterns wrapped as `^(?:...)$`, which nmdc-runtime's ID minter can't read until https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-runtime/pull/1659 is deployed. What consumers can install is unchanged: the package still allows `linkml-runtime>=1.9.0,<2.0.0`. https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3529 later moved the lock to 1.12.1 for the release.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3528 (Move dependency management from Poetry to uv), by @turbomam. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/2761 (Consider migrating from Poetry to uv for dependency management) and https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3411 (Document installing Poetry on Python 3.13 so poetry run stops searching for an interpreter). This changes how nmdc-schema is developed and built, not how it is installed.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3529 (Lock linkml 1.12.1 by overriding pronto's chardet cap in uv.lock), by @turbomam. The release is built with linkml and linkml-runtime 1.12.1. The published dependency ranges stay `linkml>=1.9.0,<2.0.0` and `linkml-runtime>=1.9.0,<2.0.0`, so consumers keep the linkml they lock. The override is in our `uv.lock` only (https://github.com/althonos/pronto/issues/247).
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3536 (Remove the requests warning suppression from the Makefile), by @turbomam. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/2875 (Suppress or resolve RequestsDependencyWarning from urllib3/chardet version mismatch) and https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/2889 (Remove RequestsDependencyWarning suppression when requests fixes version check).
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3488 (Allow Python 3.14 and test it in CI), by @turbomam. `requires-python` goes from `>=3.10,<3.14` to `>=3.10,<3.15`. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3487.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3486 (Allow version 3.x of the `deprecated` dependency), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3503 (Raise the pymdown-extensions cap to <13.0.0), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3502 (Pin the three owlgen options whose defaults will change), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3472 (Bump the python-dependencies group with 4 updates), by Dependabot.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3530 (Bump the python-dependencies group with 5 updates), by Dependabot. Its linkml-runtime 1.12.1 lock change was reverted by https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3532.

## Tests and CI

- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3525 (Test the schema against linkml 1.12's structured pattern handling), by @turbomam. It merged into the branch of https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3524, not into main directly.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3512 (Add doctests for LinkML 1.12 wrapped id patterns), by @turbomam. The doctests are in `nmdc_schema/id_helpers.py`, which ships in the package.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3531 (Bump the github-actions group with 3 updates), by Dependabot.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3534 (Bump astral-sh/setup-uv from 9.0.0 to 10.3.0 in the github-actions group), by Dependabot.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3515 (Test the installed wheel weekly with the newest allowed dependencies), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3504 (Test that new NMDC multivalued slots have plural names), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3462 (Pin poetry 2.5.1 everywhere and test that the pins agree), by @turbomam.

## Docs and repository tooling

- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3431 (Document schema consumers and compatibility rollout), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3496 (Let the OLS4 embeddings search run on named classes, slots or enums), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3497 (Give each SIP example replaced from MIxS a reason comment), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3498 (Document the isotopolog spelling rewrite applied to imported MIxS text), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3509 (Remove assets/mongodb_queries), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3552 (Add a page on what nmdc-schema 11.25.0 means for its consumers), by @turbomam.

## Pre-releases

- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3535 (Generate release artifacts for nmdc-schema 11.25.0rc1), by @turbomam. 11.25.0rc1, built with linkml 1.11.1, published to PyPI on 2026-10-15 01:34 UTC.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3538 (Generate release artifacts for nmdc-schema 11.25.0rc2), by @turbomam. 11.25.0rc2, built with linkml 1.12.1, published to PyPI on 2026-10-15 02:33 UTC.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3566 (Generate release artifacts for nmdc-schema 11.25.0rc3), by @turbomam. 11.25.0rc3, built with linkml 1.12.1.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/compare/v11.24.1...v11.25.0-rc.3

releases.body:
## Highlights

This is a pre-release for testing. It is rc1 rebuilt with linkml and linkml-runtime 1.12.1; the schema source is unchanged since rc1. Notes for everything since 11.24.1: https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/releases/tag/v11.25.0-rc.1

What consumers see from the linkml 1.12 build:

- **`id` patterns are wrapped as `^(?:...)$`** in the JSON Schema, for example Biosample's becomes `^(?:^(nmdc):bsm-...$)$`. Code that checks a pattern's prefix needs updating. `nmdc_schema.get_typecode_for_future_ids` reads both forms. nmdc-runtime's minter needs https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-runtime/pull/1659.
- **`type` also accepts the full class URI**, for example `https://w3id.org/nmdc/Study` as well as `nmdc:Study`: https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3537
- **Optional slots ranged on an enum or class also accept `null`** (191 class-slot pairs on 125 slots).
- **The generated Python classes** (`nmdc.py`) compile filled-in id patterns; a test fails if any still holds a `{...}` placeholder.

**Migration:** none beyond rc1's check for `collection_time_inc`.

**For consumers:** test with `nmdc-schema==11.25.0rc2`. Consumers keep their own linkml version; the published dependency ranges are unchanged.

## What's Changed
* Lock linkml 1.12.1 by overriding pronto's chardet cap in uv.lock by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3529
* Remove the requests warning suppression from the Makefile by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3536
* Generate release artifacts for nmdc-schema 11.25.0rc2 by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3538

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/compare/v11.25.0-rc.1...v11.25.0-rc.2

releases.body:
## Highlights

This is a pre-release for testing. It adds stable isotope probing (SIP) modeling, removes `collection_time_inc` from `Biosample`, and is the first release built and published with uv instead of Poetry.

- **SIP modeling:** new classes `IsotopeLabelingProcess`, `DensityGradientFractionationProcess`, `IsotopologAddition` and `IsotopologComposition`, and new enums `IsotopeEnum`, `IsotopologApproachEnum` and `IsotopologLabelEnum`.
- **`collection_time_inc` removed from `Biosample`.** The 11.24.1 to 11.25.0 migrator changes nothing; it stops with an error if any Biosample still has the slot, so a person can decide where the value goes.
- **EMSL analysis types:** ten new `AnalysisTypeEnum` values, for example `proteomics` and `imaging - electron`.
- **Python 3.14:** `requires-python` is now `>=3.10,<3.15`.
- **Build:** dependencies are locked in `uv.lock`, and the package is built with hatchling and `uv-dynamic-versioning`. The published dependency ranges are unchanged.

**Migration:** no data transformation. The migrator only checks for `collection_time_inc`.

**Known issue:** a rule-required single-valued slot accepts an explicit `null` in the JSON Schema, which affects the new `IsotopologAddition`: https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3424

**LinkML:** built with linkml and linkml-runtime 1.11.1. The linkml 1.12 change waits for nmdc-runtime: https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3529

**For consumers:** pre-releases are not installed unless asked for. Test with `nmdc-schema==11.25.0rc1`.

## What's Changed
* **SIP modeling**
  * Add new classes for SIP metagenomics data modeling by @aclum in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3396
  * Get the SIP branch green: regenerate mixs.yaml, objectify examples, repair the import TSV by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3400
  * Mark the term-less isotopolog example provisional and fix typos in the SIP additions by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3414
  * Require a term on isotopolog and add hetero_isotopolog for labeled inputs with no PubChem compound by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3421
  * Rename and define the SIP classes and slots that nmdc-schema owns by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3422
  * Rename two SIP slots and add the SIP examples and substrate values by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3468
  * Give each SIP example replaced from MIxS a reason comment by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3497
  * Document the isotopolog spelling rewrite applied to imported MIxS text by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3498
* **`collection_time_inc` removal**
  * Finalize deprecation of `collection_time_inc` by @JamesTessmer in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3470
  * Remove `collection_time_inc` rows from NCBI mapping and OLS4 alignment assets by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3474
  * Add a migrator check that fails on `collection_time_inc` by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3495
* **Other schema changes**
  * Add EMSL specific analysis types to support user submissions by @bmeluch in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3471
  * Record which slot each method slot describes by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3499
  * Keep five descriptions to the definition and move the rest to comments by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3519
  * Remove the yq lines that create an empty `internal_standard` slot by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3508
  * Record elements removed during v11 in deprecated.yaml, with a catalog of all removals by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3478
* **Structured id patterns and LinkML 1.12 preparation**
  * Add interpolated: true to three id structured patterns by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3483
  * Give each schema module its own copy of the settings its patterns use by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3524
  * Prepare `get_typecode_for_future_ids` for LinkML v1.12 and add associated test by @kheal in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3511
  * Add doctests for LinkML 1.12 wrapped id patterns by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3512
  * Test the schema against linkml 1.12's structured pattern handling by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3525
  * Pin the three owlgen options whose defaults will change by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3502
  * Hold our lock at linkml-runtime 1.11 until nmdc-runtime can read wrapped id patterns by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3532
* **Build, packaging and dependency management**
  * Move dependency management from Poetry to uv by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3528
  * Allow Python 3.14 and test it in CI by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3488
  * Allow version 3.x of the `deprecated` dependency by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3486
  * Pin poetry 2.5.1 everywhere and test that the pins agree by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3462
  * Raise the pymdown-extensions cap to <13.0.0 by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3503
  * Test the installed wheel weekly with the newest allowed dependencies by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3515
  * Generate release artifacts for nmdc-schema 11.25.0rc1 by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3535
* **Docs and repo tooling**
  * Document schema consumers and compatibility rollout by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3431
  * Scan for retired element names in files nothing checks by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3479
  * Let the OLS4 embeddings search run on named classes, slots or enums by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3496
  * Test that new NMDC multivalued slots have plural names by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3504
  * Remove assets/mongodb_queries by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3509
* **Dependabot updates**
  * Bump the python-dependencies group with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3472
  * Bump the python-dependencies group with 5 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3530
  * Bump the github-actions group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3531
  * Bump astral-sh/setup-uv from 9.0.0 to 10.3.0 in the github-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3534

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/compare/v11.24.1...v11.25.0-rc.1

releases.body:
**Version note:** this release is tagged `v11.25` and published to PyPI as `11.25`, not `11.25.0`. pip and uv treat `nmdc-schema==11.25.0` as this release. The notes below call it 11.25.0.

## Summary

v11.25.0 removes the Biosample slot `collection_time_inc`, adds classes and slots for stable isotope probing (SIP) metagenomics, adds EMSL analysis types, imports its MIxS slots from MIxS v7.0.1 instead of v6.3.0, supports Python 3.14, and is built with linkml and linkml-runtime 1.12.1. It is a minor release even though it removes a slot. Removals in v11 have been released as minor versions, which does not match the rule in MAINTAINERS.md; that is being discussed in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/2876.

For consumers that read the generated JSON Schema, the linkml 1.12 build changes four things: id patterns now have the form `^(?:(nmdc):...)$` (for example `^(?:(nmdc):sty-([0-9][a-z]{0,6}[0-9])-([A-Za-z0-9]{1,}))$`), `type` also accepts the full class URI, optional enum- and class-ranged slots accept `null`, and slot examples appear in the JSON Schema. nmdc-runtime's ID minter reads only patterns that start `^(nmdc):`, so nmdc-runtime must take https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-runtime/pull/1659 (Read LinkML 1.12 wrapped id patterns in the minter's typecodes(); head 1171f379, which expects the `^(?:(nmdc):` form) in the same change that moves its pin to 11.25.0. What changes for each consumer and what each has to do is on this docs page: https://microbiomedata.github.io/nmdc-schema/release-11.25.0/

## What consumers need to do

- **nmdc-runtime:** merge https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-runtime/pull/1659 in the same change that moves the pin to 11.25.0. Without it the minter finds no typecodes.
- **nmdc-server:** nothing for nmdc-schema 11.25.0. Keep `nmdc-submission-schema==11.24.0` until https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-server/issues/2401 is fixed.
- **submission-schema:** move the dev pin, rebuild and release nmdc-submission-schema 11.25.0.
- **nmdc_mass_spectrometry_metadata_generation and nmdc-mass-spec-automation:** move their pins to 11.25.0, which fixes their linkml 1.12 failures.
- **nmdc-lakehouse and nmdc-lakehouse-schema:** accept 11.25.0 as a source version (https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-lakehouse/pull/396, https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-lakehouse-schema/pull/28).
- **Anything that reads pattern strings from the JSON Schema** must accept the `^(?:...)$` wrapping. `nmdc_schema.get_typecode_for_future_ids` already does.

Known gaps shipping in 11.25.0: `type` also accepts the full class URI (https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3537), and optional enum- and class-ranged slots accept `null` (https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3424).

## Migration

`migrator_from_11_24_1_to_11_25_0` changes no data. It fails if any `biosample_set` document still has `collection_time_inc`. No other change can invalidate existing data: a SchemaView diff from v11.24.1 found `collection_time_inc` was the only removal, the MIxS v7.0.1 import leaves the JSON Schema unchanged apart from descriptions, titles and examples, and on 2026-10-15 none of 1,902,502 patterned values or 51,744,347 functional_annotation_agg documents in production failed the new patterns.

## Schema changes

- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3396 (Add new classes for SIP metagenomics data modeling), by @aclum. Adds the classes `IsotopeLabelingProcess`, `DensityGradientFractionationProcess`, `IsotopologAddition` and `IsotopologComposition`, 16 slots, and the enums `IsotopeEnum`, `IsotopologApproachEnum` and `IsotopologLabelEnum`. Adds permissible values to `ChemicalEntityEnum`, `ProtocolCategoryEnum` (`stable_isotope_probing`), `ProtocolForEnum` and `UnitEnum` (`g/mL`).
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3499 (Record which slot each method slot describes), by @turbomam. Adds a `method_for` annotation to 21 method slots, for example `ph_meth` gets `method_for: ph`.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3483 (Add interpolated: true to three id structured patterns), by @turbomam. Fixes the `id` patterns of `ChromatographicSeparationProcess`, `Manifest` and `MixingProcess`, which linkml 1.12 would otherwise leave as literal `{id_nmdc_prefix}` text. The expanded patterns are unchanged under linkml 1.11.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3508 (Remove the yq lines that create an empty `internal_standard` slot), by @turbomam. Removes an unused stub slot. It was introduced after v11.24.1, so v11.24.1 users see no change.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3471 (Add EMSL specific analysis types to support user submissions), by @bmeluch. Adds 10 permissible values to `AnalysisTypeEnum`, matching the analysis options in the EMSL submission templates, for example `proteomics`, `isotope profiling` and `imaging - xray`. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/2629 and https://github.com/microbiomedata/issues/issues/1137.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3524 (Give each schema module its own copy of the settings its patterns use), by @turbomam. linkml-runtime 1.12 fills in a `structured_pattern` only from the `settings:` of the module that defines it (https://github.com/linkml/linkml/issues/4135), so each module now carries a copy of the settings it uses, kept in sync from `nmdc.yaml` by `src/scripts/sync_module_settings.py`. Patterns resolve the same under 1.11.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3519 (Keep five descriptions to the definition and move the rest to comments), by @turbomam. Text only. Three of the changed descriptions are `MetadataBadgeEnum` values, which the Data Portal shows as badge tooltips.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3542 (Fix 16 spelling errors in schema descriptions and docs), by @turbomam. Text only.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3544 (Keep the base id slot's MAG example out of every class's id), by @turbomam. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3540 (Under linkml 1.12, every class's id example is the base slot's MAG id, which fails 40 class patterns).
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3545 (Give each class its own id example, using production ids), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3501 (Import MIxS v7.0.1), by @turbomam. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3480 (Import MIxS v7.0.1 (we still import v6.3.0)). All 504 imported MIxS slots now come from MIxS v7.0.1; 492 of them moved from v6.3.0. NMDC keeps the name `estimated_size` (MIxS renamed it `estimated_genome_size`, recorded as a structured alias) and keeps `env_medium` single-valued (MIxS v7.0.0 made it multivalued), so no migrator is needed: JSON Schema built from main and from the branch on 2026-10-14 was identical apart from descriptions, titles and examples. `salinity_meth`, which MIxS dropped after v6.1.1, now uses the default `nmdc:` URI and no longer maps to MIXS:0000341, which returns 404. Approved by @mslarae13. Adopting `estimated_genome_size` (https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3526) or a multivalued `env_medium` (https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3527) later would need a migrator.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3549 (Leave anchoring of structured patterns to linkml), by @turbomam. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3539. linkml 1.12 adds its own `^(?:...)$` around structured patterns, so rc2 shipped doubled anchors such as `^(?:^(nmdc):sty-...$)$`. 107 structured patterns drop their own `^` and `$`, so all 40 NMDC id patterns now read `^(?:(nmdc):...)$`. What matches is unchanged. Three of 522 patterns stay doubled: `salinity_meth` (kept for submission-schema, which resolves patterns with linkml-runtime 1.9.5) and the imported MIxS slots `cult_root_med` and `genetic_mod`.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3555 (Correct the MIxS release that dropped host_family_relation and soil_text_measure), by @turbomam. Text only: the notes on those two slots now say MIxS dropped them in v6.2.0, not v6.2.2.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3516 (Record structured alias origins in source, not contexts), by @turbomam. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3454. 14 structured aliases move their origin from `contexts` to `source`, and a new test requires a `source` on every structured alias. Alias metadata only.

## Removals and deprecations

- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3470 (Finalize deprecation of `collection_time_inc`), by @JamesTessmer. Removes `collection_time_inc` from `Biosample` and records it in `deprecated.yaml`. Use `collection_time` for the harvested sample's collection time.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3474 (Remove `collection_time_inc` rows from NCBI mapping and OLS4 alignment assets), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3478 (Record elements removed during v11 in deprecated.yaml, with a catalog of all removals), by @turbomam. Adds `make retired-element-catalog` and `assets/schema_element_history/retired_elements.tsv`.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3479 (Scan for retired element names in files nothing checks), by @turbomam.

## Migrator

- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3495 (Add a migrator check that fails on `collection_time_inc`), by @turbomam. `migrator_from_11_24_1_to_11_25_0` changes no data. It raises if any `biosample_set` document still has `collection_time_inc`, because there is no automatic place to move the value.

## Python package and dependencies

- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3511 (Prepare `get_typecode_for_future_ids` for LinkML v1.12 and add associated test), by @kheal. With linkml-runtime 1.12, `get_typecode_for_future_ids` returned `None` for several classes, which breaks ID minting. nmdc-schema allows `linkml-runtime>=1.9.0,<2.0.0`, and 1.12.0 has been on PyPI since 2026-10-08 (1.12.1 since 2026-10-13), so a pip install of v11.24.1 can already get the broken combination. This release fixes it for both 1.11 and 1.12.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3532 (Hold our lock at linkml-runtime 1.11 until nmdc-runtime can read wrapped id patterns), by @turbomam. Puts the repo's own lock back at linkml-runtime 1.11.1 after the Dependabot update in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3530 moved it to 1.12.1. A release built under 1.12 would ship id patterns wrapped as `^(?:...)$`, which nmdc-runtime's ID minter can't read until https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-runtime/pull/1659 is deployed. What consumers can install is unchanged: the package still allows `linkml-runtime>=1.9.0,<2.0.0`. https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3529 later moved the lock to 1.12.1 for the release.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3528 (Move dependency management from Poetry to uv), by @turbomam. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/2761 (Consider migrating from Poetry to uv for dependency management) and https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3411 (Document installing Poetry on Python 3.13 so poetry run stops searching for an interpreter). This changes how nmdc-schema is developed and built, not how it is installed.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3529 (Lock linkml 1.12.1 by overriding pronto's chardet cap in uv.lock), by @turbomam. The release is built with linkml and linkml-runtime 1.12.1. The published dependency ranges stay `linkml>=1.9.0,<2.0.0` and `linkml-runtime>=1.9.0,<2.0.0`, so consumers keep the linkml they lock. The override is in our `uv.lock` only (https://github.com/althonos/pronto/issues/247).
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3536 (Remove the requests warning suppression from the Makefile), by @turbomam. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/2875 (Suppress or resolve RequestsDependencyWarning from urllib3/chardet version mismatch) and https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/2889 (Remove RequestsDependencyWarning suppression when requests fixes version check).
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3488 (Allow Python 3.14 and test it in CI), by @turbomam. `requires-python` goes from `>=3.10,<3.14` to `>=3.10,<3.15`. Closes https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/issues/3487.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3486 (Allow version 3.x of the `deprecated` dependency), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3503 (Raise the pymdown-extensions cap to <13.0.0), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3502 (Pin the three owlgen options whose defaults will change), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3472 (Bump the python-dependencies group with 4 updates), by Dependabot.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3530 (Bump the python-dependencies group with 5 updates), by Dependabot. Its linkml-runtime 1.12.1 lock change was reverted by https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3532.

## Tests and CI

- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3525 (Test the schema against linkml 1.12's structured pattern handling), by @turbomam. It merged into the branch of https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3524, not into main directly.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3512 (Add doctests for LinkML 1.12 wrapped id patterns), by @turbomam. The doctests are in `nmdc_schema/id_helpers.py`, which ships in the package.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3531 (Bump the github-actions group with 3 updates), by Dependabot.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3534 (Bump astral-sh/setup-uv from 9.0.0 to 10.3.0 in the github-actions group), by Dependabot.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3515 (Test the installed wheel weekly with the newest allowed dependencies), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3504 (Test that new NMDC multivalued slots have plural names), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3462 (Pin poetry 2.5.1 everywhere and test that the pins agree), by @turbomam.

## Docs and repository tooling

- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3431 (Document schema consumers and compatibility rollout), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3496 (Let the OLS4 embeddings search run on named classes, slots or enums), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3497 (Give each SIP example replaced from MIxS a reason comment), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3498 (Document the isotopolog spelling rewrite applied to imported MIxS text), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3509 (Remove assets/mongodb_queries), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3552 (Add a page on what nmdc-schema 11.25.0 means for its consumers), by @turbomam.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3569 (Correct nine claims on the 11.25.0 consumer page), by @turbomam.

## Pre-releases

- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3535 (Generate release artifacts for nmdc-schema 11.25.0rc1), by @turbomam. 11.25.0rc1, built with linkml 1.11.1, published to PyPI on 2026-10-15 01:34 UTC.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3538 (Generate release artifacts for nmdc-schema 11.25.0rc2), by @turbomam. 11.25.0rc2, built with linkml 1.12.1, published to PyPI on 2026-10-15 02:33 UTC.
- https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3566 (Generate release artifacts for nmdc-schema 11.25.0rc3), by @turbomam. 11.25.0rc3, built with linkml 1.12.1, published to PyPI on 2026-10-15 18:23 UTC. 11.25.0 is built from the same schema source.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/compare/v11.24.1...v11.25.0

releases.body:
**Adds `titles`** to 35 `Biosample` slots and to the `MetadataBadgeEnum` values, so the Data Portal can show them as labels. Also adds `SeqCenter` to `ProcessingInstitutionEnum`. No migration needed.

Note for Python users: in **`nmdc_pydantic`**, the `MetadataBadgeEnum` members are now capitalized (`Biogeochemistry`, `Host_Information`, `Expert_Curation`); their values are unchanged. `nmdc_schema.nmdc` keeps the old member names.


## Schema changes
* Add titles to Biosample slots that lacked one by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3451
* Add titles to MetadataBadgeEnum values by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3456
* Add SeqCenter to ProcessingInstitutionEnum by @samobermiller in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3436
* Drop the mod_date re-evaluation claim from the badges description by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3442

## Documentation
* Update identifiers.md documentation by @aclum in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3437

## Tests and examples
* Fail on repeated keys in example data, and fix the seven files that have them by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3453
* Test that badge subsets only use what the nmdc-runtime badge job can read by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3441

## Release
* Add no-op migrator from 11.24.0 to 11.24.1 by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3458
* Generate release artifacts for nmdc-schema 11.24.1 by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3461

## Dependencies
* Remove unused psycopg2-binary from the dev group by @turbomam in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3457
* Bump the github-actions group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3438
* Bump the python-dependencies group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3439
* Bump the github-actions group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3445
* Bump the python-dependencies group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3446
* Bump oauthlib from 3.3.1 to 4.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/pull/3449

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/microbiomedata/nmdc-schema/compare/v11.24.0...v11.24.1
